elements.name: Chiller hall
elements.about: Chillers and pumps that make the cold water used to cool the air in every Port Homes building.

elements.name: Air handling hall
elements.about: Big fans and filters that draw stale air from the precinct's ducts, clean it and send fresh air back.

elements.name: Stairs and lifts
elements.about: Stairs, lifts and service risers serving every floor; also the protected escape route in a fire.

elements.name: Control room
elements.about: Plant operators watch power, air and water for the whole precinct on screens here, round the clock.

elements.name: Switch room
elements.about: Rows of switchgear that route power to each street and building, and cut it off when there is a fault.

elements.name: Battery room
elements.about: Banks of batteries that keep the precinct's lights and controls on for hours if the power fails.

elements.name: Water pump room
elements.about: Pumps that keep the precinct's fresh water at pressure and push waste water down to the service layer.

elements.name: Water treatment room
elements.about: Filters and UV lamps that clean recycled water before it goes back into the pipes.

elements.name: Workshop
elements.about: Benches and tools where the plant crew repair pumps, valves and fans.

elements.name: Locker room
elements.about: Lockers and changing benches for staff arriving for their shift.

elements.name: Staff toilets and showers
elements.about: Toilets, showers and changing space for the staff.

elements.about: Racked spare pumps, valves, filters and fuses, so repairs never wait for parts.
